actionType.title: Action Type
actionType.description: One of: Query, Validation, Decision, Calculation, Create, Update, Escalation, Tool_Call, Delete. Pick the type that best matches the step.

agentId.title: Agent Id
agentId.description: Use the same Agent Id used to start the session.

inputContext.title: Input Context
inputContext.description: Summarize what the agent evaluated for this step — the inputs, fields, or data considered.

outputResult.title: Output Result
outputResult.description: State what the agent produced, decided, or returned for this step.

reasoning.title: Reasoning
reasoning.description: Explain in plain language why the agent took this step. This is shown directly in the audit trail.

sessionId.title: Session Id
sessionId.description: Use the Session Id returned by Start AgentLedger Session.
